pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take:
**You're all hopeless, but "Bubba G" is the only one with a clue.**

Let's start with "Mustard Boy" Zach — his decision to draft Brazil might seem smart on paper, but that's where his competence ends. Brazil's flair will cut through Norway like a knife through butter. Zach's problem is he thought grabbing just one Tier 1 team would carry him. You're wrong. This is World Cup drafting, not a one-team show. In his deficient strategy, picking the likes of Saudi Arabia shows he might be confusing FIFA video games with real-life prowess. Brazil will dismantle Devin's Norway, and it will prove yet again why Zach's 35 total points are a testament to his amateur tactics.

Meanwhile, "The Noisemaker" Rafe is an absolute joke. He couldn't draft his way out of a paper bag. His three first picks not even qualifying is a humiliation that will haunt him forever. When Mexico faces "The Backpass Assassin" Gayden's England, it will be a battle of the clueless, but Gayden's penchant for a pass-back style will be his undoing. England will outclass an ill-prepared Mexico side, showcasing Rafe's total misunderstanding of international soccer dynamics. Gunner, or "Bubba G," meanwhile, leads the pack because he actually knows what he's doing. His smooth victories with France and Morocco serve as indisputable proof that he's the operator among a group of pretenders. Cheers to competence, as rare as it is in this pool.
